_comment: Fetch dependencies from the internet into a scratch directory while the rest of the machine stays unreachable. The inverse of 32. Shows that egress 'allow' on Seatbelt is all-or-nothing (no per-host filtering -- allowedHosts/egress.allow are rejected), and that 'allow' does NOT imply loopback: hostLoopback still has to be opted into.

process.commandLine:
echo 'Dependency fetch: open egress, locked-down filesystem'; echo '============================================================'; echo ''; mkdir -p /tmp/mxc_deps && curl -s --max-time 10 --noproxy '*' -o /tmp/mxc_deps/zen.txt https://api.github.com/zen && [ -s /tmp/mxc_deps/zen.txt ] && echo 'Fetched https://api.github.com/zen into /tmp/mxc_deps/zen.txt' || echo 'NOTE: real-world fetch skipped (no internet?)'; echo ''; python3 - <<'MXCEOF'
import errno, os, socket, sys
rc = 0
def report(label, expect, got, detail):
    global rc
    ok = (got == expect)
    if not ok:
        rc = 1
    print("  %-46s %s" % (label, "SUCCESS" if ok else "ERROR"))
    print("       expected %-14s got %s%s" % (expect, got, detail))
def fs(path):
    try:
        os.listdir(path) if os.path.isdir(path) else open(path, "rb").read(1)
        return "READABLE", ""
    except OSError as e:
        return errno.errorcode.get(e.errno, str(e.errno)), "  (%s)" % e.strerror
def tcp(host, port):
    s = socket.socket(); s.settimeout(5)
    try:
        s.connect((host, port)); return "CONNECTED", ""
    except OSError as e:
        return errno.errorcode.get(e.errno, str(e.errno)), "  (%s)" % e.strerror
    finally:
        s.close()

print("Seatbelt has no per-host filtering, so egress is all-or-nothing.")
print("Confine the blast radius with the filesystem policy instead.")
print("Requires working internet access.")
print("")
g, x = tcp("1.1.1.1", 443);   report("outbound to a public IP is allowed", "CONNECTED", g, x)
g, x = fs("/Users");          report("ungranted home tree stays blocked", "EPERM", g, x)
g, x = fs("/opt/homebrew/zzz_absent")
report("control: absent path is NOT EPERM", "ENOENT", g, x)
print("")
print("egress 'allow' does NOT imply loopback -- hostLoopback is still deny.")
print("This check demands EPERM: a mere ECONNREFUSED would only mean nothing")
print("was listening on the port, which would NOT prove MXC blocked anything.")
g, x = tcp("127.0.0.1", 8931)
report("host loopback is blocked by MXC (not just closed)", "EPERM", g, x)
sys.exit(rc)
MXCEOF
rc=$?; echo ''; echo '============================================================'; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo 'Dependency fetch test complete!'; else echo 'Dependency fetch test FAILED'; fi; exit $rc
